rounds.text: Hilltone Software & Gases Ltd is currently undergoing a massive operational inflection, evidenced by a dramatic acceleration in sales growth from 21% over five years to 96% in the trailing twelve months [E14, E16]. This top-line momentum is finally translating to the bottom line, where profit growth has surged by 194% in the trailing twelve months [E19]. The company is significantly outperforming its sector peers in asset efficiency, maintaining an ROA of -0.26% compared to the sector’s -8.91% [E8]. The market has yet to price in this fundamental turnaround, as profit growth currently exceeds one-year price growth by 199% [E42]. While the stock trades near its 52-week low [E5], the valuation remains grounded with a price-to-book ratio of only 2.32x [E2]. Conceded: [E1, E4, E6, E7, E17, E18].
